title: Milestone Cascade and Action Brief for Inference Rollout
content:
Purpose:
This brief is a compact, action-first tracker for the customer inference rollout that focuses on milestone ownership, immediate blockers, and concrete mitigations. Designed for weekly QBR syncs and daily escalation during the last two sprints before go-live.

Scope and audience:
- Customer: ACME (example) inference deployment
- Audience: CS lead (owner), Solutions Eng, SRE, Model Ops, Customer PM
- Not included: internal infra procurement timelines unless they directly block an observable milestone

Quick snapshot:
- Overall cascade score: 68/100 (weighted by blocker severity and proximity to go-live)
- Current phase: Canary traffic (limited production, 10% weighted traffic)
- Primary risk: Latency regression in 2-token median under load (SLO: p95 < 250ms)

Milestone cascade table (compact):
| Milestone | Owner | Target date | Status | Top blocker(s) | Mitigation / Next action | Severity |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Kickoff & Integration Plan approved | Aisha Kapoor | 2025-09-12 | Complete | none | N/A | low |
| Data ingestion & schema verified | Tom Nguyen | 2025-10-01 | Complete | none | N/A | low |
| Test bed deploy (staging parity) | Elena Martinez | 2025-11-15 | Complete | intermittent tf-serving config mismatch | Patch applied; follow-up validation 2025-11-20 | med |
| Model variant selection & quantization profile | Omar Ruiz | 2025-12-05 | Complete | N/A | N/A | low |
| Canary traffic (10%) | Claire Bennett | 2026-01-20 | In progress | p95 latency spike under burst traffic | Increase autoscaler headroom; enable continuous batching; SRE to run soak test 2026-02-01 | high |
| Performance validation (latency/cost targets) | Elena Martinez | 2026-02-10 | At risk | regression on long-context requests | Add KV-cache warmup step to canary; temporarily restrict max_seq_len; re-run regression suite 2026-02-18 | high |
| Security & compliance sign-off | Aisha Kapoor | 2026-02-20 | In progress | Audit logs missing HSM integration evidence | Solutions Eng to provide test KMS key and audit export 2026-02-22 | med |
| Production cutover readiness | Claire Bennett | 2026-03-01 | At risk | Contract amendment (billing SLA) pending | Sales to confirm amendment by 2026-02-28; plan fallback to Dedicated variant if limit reached | high |
| Production cutover (go-live) | cross-functional | 2026-03-05 | Planned | multiple (see above) | Final go/no-go 2026-03-03; escalation on any unresolved high blockers | critical |
| Post-go-live observability & regen tests | Elena Martinez | 2026-03-12 | Planned | dashboard gaps for token-level cost | Instrument per-route token counters; retention policy set | med |

Notes on scoring and status categories:
- Status map: Complete / In progress / At risk / Blocked / Planned / Cancelled
- Severity: low / med / high / critical (used to prioritize escalation)
- Cascade score is a qualitative measure produced by CS before weekly sync: start at 100 and subtract 10–25 per high/critical unresolved blocker weighted by time to go-live.

Top open blockers (detailed):
1) Latency regression on burst workloads (owner: Elena Martinez)
   - Symptom: p95 spikes to ~420ms for 2-token responses when 50 concurrent sessions spike for 30s
   - Immediate impact: customer UX degradation; may fail SLA at scale
   - Root hypotheses: insufficient batching headroom, kernel scheduling pressure, KV-cache cold starts
   - Short-term mitigation: increase reserved batch slots for canary nodes; enable continuous batching for canary; schedule soak test 2026-02-01
   - Longer-term: review kernel configs, model compilation flags, and autoscaler policy for production

2) Missing KMS/HSM audit evidence (owner: Omar Ruiz / Aisha Kapoor)
   - Symptom: Security team requests evidence of envelope key rotation and export logs
   - Immediate impact: prevents final compliance sign-off
   - Mitigation: provide test export from staging HSM, generate step-by-step reproducible audit export doc by 2026-02-22

3) Billing SLA amendment pending (owner: Claire Bennett)
   - Symptom: legal/finance signoff for committed throughput pricing not completed
   - Immediate impact: billing and contract must be finalized before production commit
   - Mitigation: Sales to confirm letter of intent by 2026-02-28; contingency: enable Dedicated capacity with billing cap if amendment delayed

Escalation matrix (who to call):
- Day-0 (working-hours): CS owner (Aisha) -> Solutions Eng (Omar) -> SRE on-call (Elena)
- Day-0 (after-hours): SRE on-call -> Ops manager (Tom) -> CS director (VP CS)
- For legal/billing: Sales lead -> Finance -> Legal counsel queue (use jira CS-4821)

Weekly cadence and meeting artifacts:
- 30m weekly sync (Mon 9am PST): Quick cascade score, 3 blockers, 3 actions - owner updates only
- 60m Go/No-Go rehearsal (two weeks prior to cutover): dry run of rollback, traffic split, and failover to Dedicated variant
- Shared artifact links: runbook (linked_artifacts[1]), onboarding confluence page (linked_artifacts[2])

Action items (immediate):
- Elena: run 4h soak test with simulated burst profile and produce p50/p95/p99 table by 2026-02-01
- Omar: produce audit-export doc and HSM proof-of-rotation by 2026-02-22
- Claire: secure billing amendment or LOI by 2026-02-28; confirm fallback contract for Dedicated if needed
- Tom: validate autoscaler policy changes in staging and post the results to the tracker by 2026-02-03
- Aisha: run go/no-go checklist rehearsal 2026-03-03 and publish final decision memo same day

Runbook excerpt (for SRE/CS on-call):
- If p95(latency) > 350ms for > 3 consecutive 1-minute windows during canary:
  1) Pause traffic shift (Solutions Eng)
  2) Scale canary pool by +30% reserved capacity (SRE)
  3) Rollback to previous model variant if regression persists > 10 minutes (owner: Omar)
  4) Notify customer success lead and PM; log incident in CS-4821

Open questions to resolve in next sync:
- Can we temporarily cap max_seq_len for canary to eliminate long-context regressions without affecting critical flows? (impact assessment due 2026-02-04)
- What is the acceptable cost delta for enabling continuous batching during canary? (finance input)
- Confirm SLA language for latency SLOs in amendment (legal review needed)

Annex: short changelog:
- 2025-10-03 created by Aisha (initial cascade)
- 2025-11-18 update: test bed deploy complete (Elena)
- 2026-01-25 update: canary started at 10%, latency anomalies observed (Elena)
- 2026-02-25 update: added HSM audit action and hardened soak test plan (Aisha)

Next sync: Monday 2026-03-02 09:00 PST (30m) - agenda: final go/no-go rehearsal items, blocker clearance, post-cutover observability checklist

Notes to self (CS lead): keep this brief pinned to the weekly agenda and snapshot into the QBR template as the "Rollout Health" slide. Keep one-line status updates for execs and a separate detailed ticket for SRE/MLOps diagnostics.
